validation.main_reading: The reciprocal diagnostic 1/A gives alpha≈2 by construction, but no native readout in this preliminary dataset naturally shows alpha≈2.

notes: Constructed reciprocal controls are not native readouts.
A_chi_tau=0 or rank<2 cases are excluded from reciprocal diagnostics.
Positive alpha near 2 is accepted only as native evidence if it appears in native candidates.
